name: otoolebox
description: A collection of client-side web tools that run entirely in the browser. No data is sent to servers, ensuring privacy and security for all operations.

scripts.build: cd image-editor && npm install && cp node_modules/wasm-vips/lib/vips.js lib/ && cp node_modules/wasm-vips/lib/vips.wasm lib/ && cp node_modules/heic-to/dist/iife/heic-to.js lib/ && cp node_modules/exifreader/dist/exif-reader.js lib/ && cd ../barcode-generator && npm install && mkdir -p lib && cp node_modules/bwip-js/dist/bwip-js-min.js lib/ && cd ../hash-generator && npm install && mkdir -p lib && cp node_modules/crypto-js/crypto-js.js lib/ && cd ../json-utilities && npm install && mkdir -p lib && cp node_modules/jsonrepair/lib/umd/jsonrepair.js lib/ && cp node_modules/json5/dist/index.min.js lib/ && cd ../diff-utilities && npm install && mkdir -p lib && cp node_modules/diff/dist/diff.min.js lib/ && cd ../passphrase-generator && npm install && cd ../duckdb-browser && npm install && cd ../closed-loop && npm install && mkdir -p lib && cp node_modules/bwip-js/dist/bwip-js-min.js lib/
